tools.name: calculate_per_diem
tools.description: Calculates GSA CONUS lodging and M&IE allowances for one or more trips, applying first/last-day and furnished-meal deductions, and returns day-by-day results with XLSX/CSV worksheet downloads. Covers bundled GSA CONUS FY2026/FY2027 only; up to 10 trips, 10 contiguous stops per trip, 92 days between

tools.name: find_per_diem_rates
tools.description: Looks up monthly GSA CONUS lodging and M&IE rates for up to 25 ZIP codes or City, ST locations in bundled FY2026/FY2027 tables, with XLSX and CSV files. The default fiscal year is today in America/New_York. Ambiguous ZIPs return an item error; calculate_per_diem accepts county for disambiguation. Co

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_per_diem" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
